title.en: Which one is you right now?

lead.zh: 挑一个最像你的，直接跳到回答它的那一块。
lead.en: Pick the one that sounds like you, then jump to the part that answers it.

notes.en: I have a pile of local notes

sit.zh: 笔记越攒越多，双链是自己加的，整理全靠手动。你要的是现在的文件夹拿过来就能用，不是再搬一次家。
sit.en: The folder keeps growing, backlinks are hand-maintained, and tidying falls on you. You want the folder you already have to work here — not another move.

label.zh: 看怎么把文件夹接进来
label.en: See how a folder gets imported
See who your data belongs to

sit.zh: 素材散在聊天记录、书签和会议转写里，动笔时想不起自己看过哪一篇，只能从头再搜一遍。
sit.en: Material sits in chats, bookmarks and meeting transcripts. When you start writing you can't recall what you read, so you search again from scratch.

label.en: See how one entry gets processed
See what you end up with

sit.zh: 会议、需求、指标一周几十条，每一条都得当场落成能追、能复盘的东西，而不是记完就散。
sit.en: Meetings, requests and metrics arrive by the dozen each week, and each one has to land as something you can track and review — not just notes that scatter.

label.en: See what comes out of it

sit.zh: 你说的是那个懂你的材料、按你的风格替你起草的分身。现在还不会——今天能用上的是它的记忆底座：替你记、替你整理、在你写的时候把它找回来。它得先学会你。
sit.en: You mean the twin that knows your material and drafts in your voice. That one isn't here yet. What works today is its memory core: it files, organizes, and brings things back while you write. First it has to learn you.

label.zh: 看它排在路线图的哪一格
label.en: See where it sits on the roadmap
